articles.title: L&T joins hands with French co Exail for Indian Navy’s unmanned mine counter measure suite project
articles.summary: Indian engineering giant L&T has partnered with French firm Exail for the Indian Navy's crucial unmanned mine counter measure (MCM) suite project. This collaboration will equip the Navy with advanced unmanned systems for detecting and neutralizing naval mines, significantly boosting maritime security. The initiative underscores India's drive towards integrating cutting-edge global technology with indigenous capabilities for critical defence infrastructure.

articles.title: Zelenskyy vows retribution against Russia for missile strike that killed 24
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has vowed retribution against Russia following a missile strike on a Kyiv apartment building. The attack tragically killed 24 people, including three children, highlighting the brutal reality of the ongoing conflict. Zelenskyy emphasized Ukraine's commitment to holding Russia accountable for its actions and ensuring justice for the victims, signaling continued resolve amidst escalating tensions.
